page.layout: One page of text, centred block; below it an imprimatur block with licence line and date, and a signature line at right.

main_text.p: Perlegi hunc librum, cui Titulus, [Præcipuorum Theologiæ Capitum Enchiridion Didacticum] in quo nihil reperio fidei Ecclesiæ Anglicanæ, aut bonis moribus contrarium.
Tho. Grigg. R. in Christo Patri D. Humfr. Episc. Lond. a Sac. Dom.

page.notes: The page is a licence/imprimatur leaf. The date line "1664" is set on its own line below "Ex Æd. Lond. Oct. 12." and the signature is in italic at right. "Ex Æd. Lond. Oct. 12." is partly damaged; "O7" is read as "Oct." with [?] not applied as the reading is reasonably clear. Ink spots and scan edges are omitted.
